rule rep_host {
	id 0
	type replicated
	step take default
	step chooseleaf firstn 0 type host
	step emit
}
rule rep_rack_host {
	id 1
	type replicated
	step take default
	step choose firstn 2 type rack
	step chooseleaf firstn 2 type host
	step emit
}
rule ec_host {
	id 2
	type erasure
	step set_chooseleaf_tries 5
	step set_choose_tries 100
	step take default
	step chooseleaf indep 0 type host
	step emit
}
rule ec_rack_osd {
	id 3
	type erasure
	step take default
	step choose indep 3 type rack
	step choose indep 2 type osd
	step emit
}
rule rep_osd {
	id 4
	type replicated
	step take default
	step choose firstn 0 type osd
	step emit
}
rule rep_tree {
	id 5
	type replicated
	step take h-tree
	step choose firstn 0 type osd
	step emit
}
rule multi_emit {
	id 6
	type replicated
	step take r1
	step chooseleaf firstn 2 type host
	step emit
	step take r2
	step chooseleaf firstn 1 type host
	step emit
}
rule local_tries {
	id 7
	type replicated
	step set_choose_local_tries 2
	step set_choose_local_fallback_tries 5
	step take default
	step chooseleaf firstn 0 type host
	step emit
}
rule vary_stable {
	id 8
	type replicated
	step set_chooseleaf_vary_r 0
	step set_chooseleaf_stable 0
	step take default
	step chooseleaf firstn 0 type host
	step emit
}
rule flat_osd {
	id 9
	type replicated
	step take flat
	step chooseleaf firstn 0 type osd
	step emit
}
rule ec_flat {
	id 10
	type erasure
	step take flat
	step choose indep 0 type osd
	step emit
}
rule uniform_indep {
	id 11
	type erasure
	step take h-uniform
	step choose indep 0 type osd
	step emit
}
rule rep_minus {
	id 12
	type replicated
	step take default
	step chooseleaf firstn -1 type host
	step emit
}
